package.description: 基于 libmpv 与 yt-dlp 的 YouTube、Bilibili 桌面视频播放器与下载工具。

en-US.description: Desktop video player and downloader for YouTube and Bilibili built on libmpv and yt-dlp.
en-US.longDescription: Tube_Ultimate_Player is a Windows desktop video player and download tool built on PySide6, yt-dlp, and libmpv. It supports YouTube and Bilibili search, home feeds, URL playback, playlist management, and downloads, with quality switching, playback speed, subtitles, DLNA casting, a download queue, favorites, and history.

zh-CN.description: 基于 libmpv 与 yt-dlp 的 YouTube、Bilibili 桌面视频播放器与下载工具。
zh-CN.longDescription: Tube_Ultimate_Player 是一款基于 PySide6、yt-dlp 与 libmpv 的 Windows 桌面视频播放器与下载工具。它同时支持 YouTube 与 Bilibili 的搜索、首页浏览、URL 播放、播放列表管理与下载，提供清晰度切换、倍速、字幕、DLNA 投屏、下载队列、收藏与历史等功能。
zh-CN.name: Tube_Ultimate_Player
